definitions.explanation: A thin line or mark on a surface.
Muscle fibers or tendons in the body.
The main story or sequence of events.
A coherent line of reasoning or proper procedure.

examples.japanese: {筋肉|きんにく}の{筋|すじ}を{痛|いた}めた。
この{映画|えいが}の{筋|すじ}を{教|おし}えて。
examples.english: Tell me the plot of this movie.

examples.japanese: それは{筋|すじ}が{通|とお}らない。
examples.english: That doesn't make sense. / That's illogical.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い{筋|すじ}が{入|はい}った{石|いし}を{拾|ひろ}った。
examples.english: I picked up a stone with white streaks in it.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}に{飛行機雲|ひこうきぐも}の{筋|すじ}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: You can see a contrail streak in the sky.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}の{筋|すじ}が{頬|ほお}に{残|のこ}っていた。
examples.english: Tear streaks were left on her cheeks.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}の{筋|すじ}を{伸|の}ばしてから{走|はし}ろう。
examples.english: Let's stretch our leg muscles before running.

examples.japanese: {首|くび}の{筋|すじ}を{違|ちが}えてしまった。
examples.english: I pulled a muscle in my neck.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}の{筋|すじ}が{分|わ}からなくなった。
examples.english: I lost track of the storyline.

examples.japanese: あらすじだけでは{筋|すじ}の{面白|おもしろ}さは{伝|つた}わらない。
examples.english: The charm of the plot can't be conveyed through a summary alone.

examples.japanese: {筋|すじ}を{通|とお}して{話|はな}さないと、{相手|あいて}に{失礼|しつれい}だ。
examples.english: It's rude if you don't follow proper procedure when speaking to the other party.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}の{言|い}うことはいつも{筋|すじ}が{通|とお}っている。
examples.english: What that person says always makes logical sense.

notes:
{筋|すじ} has multiple related meanings centering on the concept of a "line" or "thread."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {筋|すじ}が{通|とお}る (to make sense, to be logical)
- {筋|すじ}を{通|とお}す (to follow proper procedure)
- {筋|すじ}{違|ちが}い (irrelevant, off-topic; also: muscle strain)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血|ち}{筋|すじ} (bloodline, lineage)
- {道|みち}{筋|すじ} (route, path)
- {話|はなし}の{筋|すじ} (storyline)
- {筋肉|きんにく} (muscle)

SENSE CONNECTIONS:
The meanings are connected through the idea of a continuous line: physical lines → muscle fibers → storyline → logical thread.
